  "check_code": "import re
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path


def _db(workspace):
    return sqlite3.connect(Path(workspace).parent / "system" / "seeyon_efficiency_oa" / "state.db")


def _norm(value):
    return re.sub(r"[\s\u3000,:：;；|/\\()（）\[\]【】._-]+", "", str(value or "")).lower()


def check_audit_evidence_recorded(workspace):
    con = _db(workspace)
    try:
        rows = con.execute(
            "SELECT review_event_id, task_id, event_type, event_date, evidence_ref, event_note "
            "FROM review_events WHERE task_id=? AND event_type='evidence_submitted' "
            "AND event_date < ? ORDER BY event_date, review_event_id",
            ("RT-2024-1120-023", "2024-12-05"),
        ).fetchall()
        matches = []
        task_token = _norm("RT-2024-1120-023")
        for row in rows:
            event_id, task_id, event_type, event_date, evidence_ref, note = row
            ref_text, text = _norm(evidence_ref), _norm(note)
            ref_is_audit_rebuild = (
                any(token in ref_text for token in ("audit", "审计"))
                and any(token in ref_text for token in ("status", "state", "状态"))
                and any(token in ref_text for token in ("rebuild", "reconstruction", "重建"))
            )
            note_has_ordering = any(token in text for token in ("最后", "后续", "latest", "last", "review20241205023", "20241205"))
            note_has_returned = any(token in text for token in ("review_returned", "returned", "退回"))
            if (event_id.startswith("REV-NEW-") and task_token in ref_text
                    and ref_is_audit_rebuild and task_token in text
                    and any(token in text for token in ("状态", "status", "state"))
                    and any(token in text for token in ("重建", "rebuild", "reconstruction"))
                    and note_has_ordering and note_has_returned):
                matches.append(row)
        ok = len(matches) == 1
        return {"score": int(ok), "detail": "已补录唯一状态重建审计证据" if ok else "审计证据不符或数量不对: %s" % (rows,)}
    finally:
        con.close()


def check_target_status_postcondition(workspace):
    con = _db(workspace)
    try:
        status = con.execute(
            "SELECT status FROM remediation_tasks WHERE task_id=?", ("RT-2024-1120-023",)
        ).fetchone()
        latest = con.execute(
            "SELECT review_event_id, event_type, event_date FROM review_events "
            "WHERE task_id=? AND review_event_id NOT LIKE 'REV-NEW-%' "
            "ORDER BY event_date DESC, review_event_id DESC LIMIT 1",
            ("RT-2024-1120-023",),
        ).fetchone()
        ok = status == ("returned",) and latest == (
            "REV-2024-1205-023", "review_returned", "2024-12-05"
        )
        return {"score": int(ok), "detail": "目标状态与最后原始退回事件一致" if ok else "后态不符: status=%s, latest=%s" % (status, latest)}
    finally:
        con.close()


def check_preserve_history_and_other_tasks(workspace):
    con = _db(workspace)
    try:
        target_ids = [r[0] for r in con.execute(
            "SELECT review_event_id FROM review_events WHERE task_id=? AND review_event_id NOT LIKE 'REV-NEW-%' ORDER BY review_event_id",
            ("RT-2024-1120-023",),
        ).fetchall()]
        other = con.execute(
            "SELECT task_id, status FROM remediation_tasks WHERE task_id IN (?,?,?,?) ORDER BY task_id",
            ("RT-2024-1120-017", "RT-2024-1120-018", "RT-2024-1120-031", "RT-2024-1120-038"),
        ).fetchall()
        expected_other = [
            ("RT-2024-1120-017", "overdue_first"),
            ("RT-2024-1120-018", "in_review"),
            ("RT-2024-1120-031", "closed"),
            ("RT-2024-1120-038", "open"),
        ]
        ok = target_ids == ["REV-2024-1126-023", "REV-2024-1203-023", "REV-2024-1205-023"] and other == expected_other
        return {"score": int(ok), "detail": "原始事件及其他任务均保持不变" if ok else "保护对象变化: target=%s, other=%s" % (target_ids, other)}
    finally:
        con.close()
